title.narrative: Activity under preparation UNDP - Business and Human Rights

description.narrative:
The action will be promoting the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights (UNGPs) with relevant stakeholders and contribute to achieving output 2 of the Annex 8 ¿Action Document for ¿EU Civil Society Facility and Media Programme for the Republic of Türkiye for 2024-2025¿ to the Decision, notably that human rights monitoring capacities of supported civil society organisations (CSOs) are reinforced. Specifically, the action foresees trainings, awareness raising, joint advocacy campaigns, and monitoring activities amongst other. The action will seek to target businesses involved in the postquake reconstruction and rehabilitation as well, with a view to ensure the respect of human rights.

Moreover, the new EU Directive on Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence (CSDD) aims to foster sustainable and responsible corporate behaviour in companies¿ operations and across their global value chains. It will introduce a duty for companies in scope to identify and address potential and actual adverse human rights and environmental impacts in their own operations, those of their subsidiaries and, where related to their chain(s) of activities, those of their business partners. In addition, the EU Action Plan on Human Rights and Democracy 2020-2024 sets as a priority to reinforce the EU¿s global leadership on Business and Human Rights, and the action in object is foreseen in this context.
